item.title: Puchikko ☆ My Lord
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: M no Jikan
  • 発売日: 2015-11-27
  • スコア: 6.07/10 (19 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 踏ちっ娘☆まいろーど
  • 英語名: Puchikko ☆ My Lord

别名

  • 踏ちっ娘（ぷちっこ）☆まいろーど

あらすじ

Yuji Numakura is a lolicon protagonist who has always wanted to get closer to loli girls. One night Yuji met a girl in the park at night. The girl said, “I don’t know how to get home,” as her twin tails swayed and she looked down sadly. The girl with an anxious face was Mom Tachibana, apparently her family had come to take a preview of some property and she had gotten lost while strolling around the city. Yuji resists the urge to take her home and did the gentlemanly thing of taking her to the police.

item.title: Zettai Kunshu! Sayo-sama!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: M no Jikan
  • 発売日: 2015-02-13
  • スコア: 5.3100000000000005/10 (24 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 絶対君主! 小夜様!
  • 英語名: Zettai Kunshu! Sayo-sama!

别名

  • Zettai Kunshu! Sayo-sama!

あらすじ

Unable to find a regular job due to the current job market, the protagonist works part-time to make ends meet.

It was just like any other day when he was looking at the classifieds and found a job opening for a “master’s servant”.

What did that even mean? A butler or something? Anyway, there had never been such a job ad before.
